map.为什么入院和出院都要评？: Why score on both admission and discharge?
map.FIM 的核心价值在「差值」而非单次数值：FIM 效能 =（出院 FIM − 入: The core value of FIM lies in the difference rather than a single number: FIM efficiency = (discharge FIM - admission FIM) / length of stay, or FIM gain = (discharge - admission) / (maximum possible score - admission score). This page only scores and grades a single assessment; multiple records can be saved in the history and compared manually. Record actual performance rather than potential, and read the cognitive and motor subscales separately, since slow cognitive improvement often signals a poorer prognosis.

map.康复结局(FIM)量表总分计算器是做什么的？: What does the FIM Independence Measure Total Score Calculator do?

map.在 18 个下拉框中选择每项得分后点击「计算总分」，页面汇总运动分、认知分与总分: Pick each item's score in the 18 dropdowns, then click Calculate total; the page sums motor, cognitive and total scores and assigns a grade. Results can be copied, saved or exported as CSV.
